sectionDesc.content: A few recent engagements across marketplaces, fintech, mobility, and SaaS. Client names are withheld.

rows.title: P&L Forecast & Scenario Model for a New Business Line
rows.challenge: The founders needed to know whether a new business line was worth launching, and what it would take to make it profitable.
work: Built unit economics from 18 months of transaction data: order value, delivery fee, commission, and courier cost per delivery
Modeled customer cohorts with month-by-month retention, including competitor-promo churn and a fee outage
Built a parametric 12-month P&L with best, base, and worst cases on CAC, churn, and pricing
rows.outcome: Operating income ranged from $86K to $1.15M across scenarios, which informed the go/no-go decision. Recommended onboarding, loyalty, and re-engagement plays worth an estimated $200K–$300K.
rows.tags: Unit Economics, Cohort Modeling, Scenario Planning

rows.title: Product & Investor-Return Model for a Home Equity Investment
rows.challenge: Assess whether a home equity investment product was competitive for homeowners and attractive to capital partners.
work: Built 10-year home-price scenarios (–5% to +15%) comparing effective APR against a 7% fixed-rate HELOC
Modeled investor IRR, MoM, and cash flows, including a $200M deployment in $100K tranches
Tested settlement-timing sensitivity for both homeowners and investors
rows.outcome: Showed the product beats 7% high-yield bonds above 2% annual appreciation. Proposed a hybrid equity-loan structure, tiered multipliers, and a 5% minimum IRR floor.
rows.tags: Financial Modeling, Product Strategy, Investor Returns

rows.title: Weekly P&L & KPI Dashboard for a City Transit Service
rows.challenge: The operator needed visibility into cost, utilization, and margin by vehicle type to improve profitability and ridership.
work: Consolidated six weeks of trip-level data into a standardized weekly P&L
Tracked rides per hour, cost and revenue per ride, and gross and contribution margin by vehicle type
Benchmarked operator vs. city cost per ride and analyzed margin trends by time of day
rows.outcome: Found vans most efficient (7.07 rides/hr at $2.58/ride) and sedans highest-margin (76%). Recommended demand-based vehicle repositioning and off-peak seat promotions.

rows.title: Churn Diagnosis & Sales Retention Playbook
rows.challenge: Cancellations were rising, and the team needed to know why, and which customers were most at risk.
work: Built a churn waterfall by cause: pricing (26%), feature gaps (26%), operations (21%), service, and bugs
Pinpointed high-churn segments by practice-management system, vertical, and product bundle
Benchmarked top competitors and ran workshops with Sales, Success, and Product
rows.outcome: Identified an estimated $200K–$300K in retainable annual revenue and delivered a sales and retention playbook for the go-to-market teams.
rows.tags: Churn Analysis, Competitive Intel, GTM Playbook
